method.h2: How we judge Claude Code review skills and tools: problems found, noise added
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Claude Code 代码审查 skill 和工具：找到多少问题，添了多少噪音
method.thesis: An AI code reviewer is judged by two numbers that pull against each other: how many real problems it finds, and how much noise it adds. On SWR-Bench, 1,000 manually verified pull requests from GitHub, current review tools find too little and do best on functional bugs; running several reviews and combining them raised F1 by up to 43.67%. Noise has a price too. In a company deployment reported at ICSE 2025, 73.8% of the AI's comments were resolved, yet the average time to close a pull request rose from 5 hours 52 minutes to 8 hours 20 minutes, and engineers named faulty, unnecessary and irrelevant comments as the drawback. ByteDance's reviewer filters its own comments in a second stage to reach 75.0% precision, and measures adoption by whether the code a comment pointed at was then changed. So we judge a Claude Code review skill or tool by what it does about both: does it filter before it posts, and can you see whether its comments were acted on.
method.thesis_zh: AI 代码审查工具要看两个互相拉扯的数：找到多少真问题，添了多少噪音。在 SWR-Bench（1,000 个人工核验过的 GitHub PR）上，现有审查工具找到的问题偏少，最擅长的是功能性 bug；把多次审查的结果合并，F1 最多能提高 43.67%。噪音也有代价：ICSE 2025 报告的一次企业部署里，AI 评论有 73.8% 被处理，但 PR 平均关闭时间从 5 小时 52 分升到 8 小时 20 分，工程师说最大的问题是评论有错、没必要、不相关。字节跳动的审查工具先生成评论，再用第二道工序过滤，精度做到 75.0%；它看评论有没有被采纳的办法，是看评论指着的那段代码之后有没有被改。所以我们看一个 Claude Code 审查 skill 或工具怎么处理这两件事：发评论前会不会先过滤，能不能看出评论有没有被采纳。
h3_routes: Six kinds of Claude Code review tools
六类 Claude Code 代码审查工具

routes.name: Code review skills
routes.how: A skill or plugin that has Claude Code or Codex review a diff on request.
routes.how_zh: 一个 skill 或插件，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 按需审查一段 diff。
routes.gain: Runs before you commit, inside the agent you already use.
routes.gain_zh: 在你已经在用的 agent 里跑，提交前就能审。
routes.cost: The same model that wrote the code reviews it; ask a second model for important changes.
routes.cost_zh: 写代码和审代码的是同一个模型；重要改动请另一个模型再看一遍。

routes.name: Local and CLI review
routes.how: A command-line reviewer you run on a branch or a diff, often with fixed rules plus an LLM.
routes.how_zh: 在分支或 diff 上运行的命令行审查工具，常是固定规则加 LLM。
routes.gain: Deterministic checks catch the known patterns; the model handles the rest.
routes.gain_zh: 确定性检查抓已知问题，剩下的交给模型。
routes.cost: Local runs leave no shared record of what was flagged and fixed.
routes.cost_zh: 本地运行不留共享记录，看不出标了什么、改了什么。

routes.name: PR review bots and CI
routes.how: Comments on every pull request, in GitHub or GitLab, as a bot or a CI step.
routes.how_zh: 在 GitHub、GitLab 的每个 PR 上发评论，以机器人或 CI 步骤的形式。
routes.gain: Every change gets a first pass, and resolved comments give you an adoption rate.
routes.gain_zh: 每个改动都先过一遍，评论被处理的比例就是采纳率。
routes.cost: Unfiltered comments slow merges; in one deployment, closing a PR took 2.5 hours longer on average.
routes.cost_zh: 不过滤的评论会拖慢合并；一次部署里，关闭一个 PR 平均多花 2.5 小时。

routes.name: Multi-agent review
routes.how: Several reviewers or models look at the same change and their findings are merged.
routes.how_zh: 多个审查者或模型看同一个改动，再合并结论。
routes.gain: Combining reviews raised F1 by up to 43.67% on SWR-Bench.
routes.gain_zh: 在 SWR-Bench 上，合并多次审查让 F1 最多提高 43.67%。
routes.cost: Several times the tokens and the wait.
routes.cost_zh: token 和等待时间都翻几倍。

routes.name: Security review
routes.how: Agents that look for vulnerabilities, some of which reproduce and fix them in a sandbox.
routes.how_zh: 专找漏洞的 agent，有些还会在沙箱里复现并修复。
routes.gain: Goes deeper on one class of problem than a general reviewer.
routes.gain_zh: 在一类问题上比通用审查挖得深。
routes.cost: A complement to a general review, not a replacement; check the grade, since these tools run code.
routes.cost_zh: 是通用审查的补充，不是替代；它们会执行代码，先看评级。

routes.name: Code review platforms
routes.how: A self-hosted service that runs reviews across a team's repositories.
routes.how_zh: 自托管服务，在团队所有仓库上跑审查。
routes.gain: One place for rules, history and adoption numbers.
routes.gain_zh: 规则、历史和采纳数据都在一处。
routes.cost: Someone has to own the rules and tune what gets posted.
routes.cost_zh: 得有人负责规则、调整哪些评论该发。

method.gap: The research measures review comments on real pull requests and in company deployments, not the specific tools listed here. Until we run them ourselves, the questions below are how we read that research.
method.gap_zh: 这些研究测的是真实 PR 和企业部署里的审查评论，不是这页列出的具体工具。在我们自己实跑之前，下面的问题是我们对研究的解读。

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every Claude Code review tool
每个 Claude Code 审查工具我们问四个问题

questions.q: Precision: does it filter or rank its own comments before posting them?
questions.q_zh: 精度：发评论前，会不会先过滤或排序？

questions.q: Context: does it read beyond the diff, into the files and history the change touches?
questions.q_zh: 上下文：会不会读 diff 之外、改动涉及的文件和历史？

questions.q: Adoption: can you see which comments were resolved or led to a code change?
questions.q_zh: 采纳：能不能看到哪些评论被处理、哪些真的带来了代码修改？

questions.q: Cost: can you limit where and how much it comments, so merges do not slow down?
questions.q_zh: 成本：能不能限制它在哪里评、评多少，免得拖慢合并？

floor_activity: while they review code
审查代码时的行为
h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: No tool beat Claude Code with nothing installed. On 12 pull requests (8 with one planted defect, 4 clean) the control found all 8 in about a minute with no false alarm; 6 of 13 tools matched it and none did better. Simple defects are not where a review tool earns its place.
findings.item_zh: 没有工具超过什么都不装的 Claude Code。12 个 PR（8 个各埋一个缺陷，4 个干净）上，对照组约一分钟找全 8 个、零误报；13 个工具里 6 个与它持平，没有更好的。简单缺陷不是审查工具体现价值的地方。

findings.item: The tools differ in noise and time, not detection: from 0.5 to 7.2 findings per pull request, and from 1 to 30 minutes for the same twelve.
findings.item_zh: 工具之间差的是噪音和耗时，不是检出：每个 PR 的发现数从 0.5 到 7.2 条，同样 12 个 PR 耗时从 1 分钟到 30 分钟。

findings.item: The defect missed most was not in the code under review: 4 of 13 passed a pull request that weakened a test's assertion. One tool ignores test files by design, one skipped test-only changes, one looks only at design decay.
findings.item_zh: 漏得最多的缺陷不在业务代码里：13 个里有 4 个放过了削弱测试断言的 PR。一个按设计不看测试文件，一个跳过了只改测试的改动，一个只查设计劣化。

findings.item: Current tools find too little on real pull requests and do best on functional bugs; combining several reviews raised F1 by up to 43.67%. The benchmark's LLM judge agreed with people about 90% of the time (SWR-Bench, 1,000 verified PRs).
findings.item_zh: 在真实 PR 上，现有工具找到的问题偏少，最擅长功能性 bug；合并多次审查让 F1 最多提高 43.67%。基准用的 LLM 评审和人工判断约 90% 一致（SWR-Bench，1,000 个核验过的 PR）。

findings.item: Comments get acted on, but they cost time: 73.8% of AI comments were resolved across 1,568 reviewed pull requests, while the average time to close one rose from 5 h 52 min to 8 h 20 min; most engineers saw a minor gain in quality (ICSE 2025, Software Engineering in Practice).
findings.item_zh: 评论会被处理，但要花时间：在 1,568 个经 AI 审查的 PR 里，73.8% 的 AI 评论被处理，PR 平均关闭时间却从 5 小时 52 分升到 8 小时 20 分；多数工程师认为代码质量只有小幅提升（ICSE 2025，工业实践专场）。

findings.item: Filtering is what makes comments worth reading: generating comments and then filtering them in a second stage reached 75.0% precision for over 12,000 weekly users at ByteDance (BitsAI-CR, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 过滤才让评论值得读：先生成、再用第二道工序过滤，字节跳动的审查工具精度做到 75.0%，每周 1.2 万多人在用（BitsAI-CR，预印本）。

findings.item: Adoption can be measured, not guessed: ByteDance counts a comment as adopted when the code it pointed at is later changed, and tracks that rate (26.7% outdated for Go) instead of asking people.
findings.item_zh: 采纳可以测，不用猜：字节跳动把"评论指着的代码之后被改了"算作采纳，持续跟踪这个比例（Go 语言为 26.7%），而不是去问人。

did.item: Ran 16 of the tools on the same 12 pull requests in a throwaway sandbox, with Claude Code and no tool as the control, and marked every review against the planted defect (gpt-6-astra, three passes). Results are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 在用完即删的沙箱里让 16 个工具审同样的 12 个 PR，并用不装工具的 Claude Code 做对照，逐份对照埋入的缺陷打分（gpt-6-astra，三遍）。结果在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, does it review code rather than write it.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、是审代码还是写代码。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: The test set is too easy to rank the best tools: the control scored full marks, so a tie at the top says nothing about harder reviews (defects that span files, or that need the business rule to see). Tools that bring their own model reviewed with gpt-6-astra and the skills with Claude Opus 5.5, so the two groups are not a like-for-like comparison. One run per tool, on one small Python service.
not_done.item_zh: 这套题太容易，排不出头部名次：对照组拿了满分，所以并列第一不能说明更难的审查（跨文件的缺陷、要懂业务规则才看得出的问题）谁更强。自带模型的工具用 gpt-6-astra 审，skill 用 Claude Opus 5.5 审，两组不是同等条件的比较。每个工具只跑了一次，对象是一个小型 Python 服务。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

title: MCP Database Tools
serp_subject: Supabase MCP, Postgres MCP & DB MCP Servers
description: Supabase MCP, Postgres MCP and other database MCP servers let an AI agent query, inspect and change your data in Supabase, Postgres, MySQL and other SQL databases. Every server here is security-graded before you connect it to production.

extra_faq.q: How do I connect Supabase to Claude Code or Cursor with MCP?
extra_faq.a: supabase/mcp is Supabase's official MCP server: add it to the client's MCP configuration (its README covers sign-in), and the assistant can query tables and manage the project. alexander-zuev/supabase-mcp-server is a community alternative with read and write queries and management through chat.
extra_faq.qZh: 怎么用 MCP 把 Supabase 接到 Claude Code 或 Cursor?
extra_faq.aZh: supabase/mcp 是 Supabase 官方的 MCP 服务:在客户端的 MCP 配置里加上它(登录授权方式见它的 README),AI 助手就能查询数据表、管理项目。alexander-zuev/supabase-mcp-server 是社区替代方案,支持读写查询和通过对话管理。

extra_faq.q: What MCP servers work with Postgres, MySQL or several databases?
extra_faq.a: Postgres: crystaldba/postgres-mcp (read/write access and performance analysis) and neondatabase/mcp-server-neon. MySQL: benborla/mcp-server-mysql. Several databases from one server: googleapis/mcp-toolbox and bytebase/dbhub. MongoDB and ClickHouse have their own: mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server, ClickHouse/mcp-clickhouse.
extra_faq.qZh: Postgres、MySQL 或多种数据库各用哪个 MCP 服务?
extra_faq.aZh: Postgres:crystaldba/postgres-mcp(读写访问和性能分析)、neondatabase/mcp-server-neon。MySQL:benborla/mcp-server-mysql。一个服务连多种数据库:googleapis/mcp-toolbox、bytebase/dbhub。MongoDB 和 ClickHouse 有各自的官方服务:mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server、ClickHouse/mcp-clickhouse。

description: Claude Code skills collections: repositories that hold many skills, plugins or subagents you install together. General collections, single-domain packs, vendor directories and the best-known awesome lists, each one security-graded before you install it.

method.h2: How we judge Claude Code skills collections: what you get, and what it costs to install all of it
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Claude Code skills 合集：装上得到什么，整包安装要付出什么
method.thesis: Most people meet Claude Code skills through a collection: one repository, hundreds of skills, one install command. The research says to be careful with that. In SkillsBench (87 tasks, run with and without skills) curated skills raised the pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5%, and focused skills of at most three modules beat large bundles. And an agent picks worse when more is put in front of it: with every tool listed, a model chose the right one 13.62% of the time, against 43.13% when only the relevant ones were retrieved (RAG-MCP). Claude Code lists installed skills in every session, but only up to a budget. We measured it: with 12 skills installed a session started at 17,781 tokens, with 112 at 24,499, and with 512 at 25,289. Past roughly a hundred skills the list stops growing because descriptions are dropped: with 512 installed, Claude Code reported about 47 skills still shown with a description and the rest by name alone. So a big collection does not cost you tens of thousands of tokens; it costs your skills their descriptions. We judge a collection by what is inside it, whether its skills follow the format, and how many of them would be left with a name only.
method.thesis_zh: 多数人是通过合集接触 Claude Code skills 的：一个仓库、几百个 skill、一条安装命令。研究提醒要小心。SkillsBench（87 个任务，装和不装 skill 各跑一遍）里，精选 skill 把通过率从 33.9% 提到 50.5%，不超过三个模块的小 skill 胜过大而全的合集。摆在 agent 面前的东西越多，它选得越差：全部列出时模型选对工具的概率是 13.62%，只检索相关的几个时是 43.13%（RAG-MCP）。Claude Code 每次会话都会列出已装的 skill，但有预算上限。我们实测过：装 12 个 skill 时会话起始是 17,781 个 token，装 112 个是 24,499，装 512 个是 25,289。超过大约一百个之后列表不再变长，因为描述被丢掉了：装 512 个时，Claude Code 自己报告只有约 47 个 skill 还带描述，其余只剩名字。所以大合集的代价不是几万 token，而是你的 skill 失去了描述。所以我们看一个合集里面有什么、它的 skill 是否符合格式、装上之后有多少个只剩名字。

routes.how_zh: 几十到几百个 skill，常附带命令和子 agent，可以整包装也可以挑着装。
routes.gain: Breadth: one place for many jobs.

routes.cost: Install hundreds and most are listed by name only; pick, do not install all.
routes.cost_zh: 装上几百个，大多数只按名字列出；挑着装，别整包装。

method.gap: The studies measure skills and tool selection in general, not these collections. The session sizes are our own measurement in Claude Code 2.1.292 on 2026-10-11; the count of skills that kept a description is Claude Code's own report of what it could see, counted by the model, so treat it as approximate.
method.gap_zh: 这些研究测的是一般意义上的 skill 和工具选择，不是这些合集。会话大小是我们 2026-10-11 在 Claude Code 里实测的；「还带描述的 skill 数」是 Claude Code 自己报告它看得到什么，由模型数出来的，只能当近似值。

h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: Install everything and Claude Code copes, Codex does not. With 512 skills installed, Claude Code opened the right one of 12 test skills 35 times of 36; Codex, which shares the SKILL.md format, managed 17 of 36 after removing every description and leaving 134 skills out of its list.
findings.item_zh: 全部装上，Claude Code 撑得住，Codex 不行。装 512 个 skill 时，Claude Code 对 12 个测试 skill 在 36 次里有 35 次打开了正确的那个；用同样 SKILL.md 格式的 Codex 去掉了所有描述、把 134 个 skill 留在列表之外，只有 17/36。

findings.item: The cost in Claude Code is descriptions, not tokens: a session started at 17,781 tokens with 12 skills, 24,499 with 112 and 25,289 with 512. Past about a hundred, skills are listed by name only.
findings.item_zh: 在 Claude Code 里代价是描述，不是 token：装 12 个 skill 时会话起始 17,781 个 token，112 个时 24,499，512 个时 25,289。超过一百个左右，skill 就只按名字列出。

findings.item: Curated beats complete. Curated skills raised the average pass rate by 16.6 points, and skills of at most three modules beat larger bundles (SkillsBench).
findings.item_zh: 精选胜过求全。精选 skill 让平均通过率提高 16.6 个百分点，不超过三个模块的 skill 胜过更大的合集（SkillsBench）。

findings.item: Listing everything costs accuracy: 13.62% correct tool selection with all tools listed, 43.13% with retrieval (RAG-MCP, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 全部列出会损失准确率：全部列出时工具选对率 13.62%，检索后 43.13%（RAG-MCP，预印本）。

findings.item: Scripts raise the risk: 26.1% of sampled skills had at least one vulnerability, and skills with scripts were 2.12 times as likely to (Agent Skills in the Wild, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 脚本会提高风险：抽样的 skill 里 26.1% 至少有一个漏洞，带脚本的出问题的概率是不带脚本的 2.12 倍（Agent Skills in the Wild，预印本）。

did.item: Counted every SKILL.md in the most-starred collections on this page against the Agent Skills format, and measured what Claude Code and Codex do with 12, 112 and 512 skills installed. Results are in the audit section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 按 Agent Skills 格式数了本页星数最高的合集里的每一个 SKILL.md，并实测了装 12、112、512 个 skill 时 Claude Code 和 Codex 的表现。结果在上面的体检区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，并且每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: We counted files and tested finding, not doing: none of these collections' skills was run for its output, so this says nothing about whether a given skill is any good. The 12 test skills have descriptive names; a skill with a vague name and no visible description may fare worse in Claude Code, and we did not test that. One run per request.
not_done.item_zh: 我们数了文件、测了「找不找得到」，没有测「做得好不好」：这些合集里的 skill 没有一个被运行来看产出，所以这说明不了某个 skill 好不好用。12 个测试 skill 的名字本身就说明用途；名字含糊又看不到描述的 skill 在 Claude Code 里可能更差，这一点没有测。每条请求只跑一次。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

extra_faq.q: How do I install skills in Codex?
extra_faq.a: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md: put it in Codex's skills folder or install it with the repo's own command, and Codex loads it when a task matches. Tools such as yynxxxxx/Codex-X manage skills, MCP servers and configuration for Codex in one interface.
extra_faq.qZh: 怎么给 Codex 安装 skill?
extra_faq.aZh: skill 是一个带 SKILL.md 的文件夹:放进 Codex 的 skills 目录,或用仓库提供的命令安装,任务匹配时 Codex 会自动加载。yynxxxxx/Codex-X 这类工具可以在一个界面里管理 Codex 的 skill、MCP 服务和配置。

method.h2: How we judge Codex skills: will Codex reach for it, and what does it cost to keep installed
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Codex skill：Codex 会不会用它，一直装着要付出什么
method.thesis: A Codex skill is a folder with a SKILL.md: a name, a description, and instructions Codex reads only when the description matches what you asked. The same format works in Claude Code. So two things decide whether a skill is worth installing. The first is whether the agent reaches for it at the right moment, which depends on its description and on what else is installed beside it. When every tool was put in front of a model at once, it chose the right one 13.62% of the time; retrieving only the relevant ones raised that to 43.13% and cut prompt tokens by more than half (RAG-MCP). The second is whether it helps once loaded: in SkillsBench (87 tasks, run with and without skills) curated skills raised the pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5%, and focused skills of at most three modules beat large bundles. So we judge a Codex skill by its description, its size, and what it needs to run, and we test triggering directly.
method.thesis_zh: Codex skill 是一个带 SKILL.md 的文件夹：一个名字、一段描述，以及只有当描述和你的请求对得上时 Codex 才会去读的说明。同样的格式在 Claude Code 里也能用。所以一个 skill 值不值得装，取决于两件事。第一是 agent 会不会在该用的时候用它，这取决于它的描述，也取决于旁边还装了什么。把所有工具一次性摆给模型时，它选对的概率只有 13.62%；只检索相关的几个，选对率升到 43.13%，提示词 token 减少一半以上（RAG-MCP）。第二是加载之后有没有用：SkillsBench（87 个任务，装和不装 skill 各跑一遍）里，精选 skill 把通过率从 33.9% 提到 50.5%，不超过三个模块的小 skill 胜过大而全的合集。所以我们看 Codex skill 的描述、体量和运行条件，并且直接实测它会不会被触发。

六类 Codex skill 与周边

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every Codex skill

questions.q: Trigger: does its description say when to use it, in words a user would type?

h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: How many skills are installed matters more than which. With 12 or 112 skills installed, Codex opened the right one 36 and 35 times of 36. With 512 it managed 17: it removed every description and left 134 skills out of its list, by its own message.
findings.item_zh: 装多少比装哪个更重要。装 12 个或 112 个 skill 时，Codex 在 36 次里有 36 次和 35 次打开了正确的 skill。装到 512 个时只有 17 次：按它自己的提示，它去掉了所有描述，并把 134 个 skill 留在列表之外。

findings.item: Without descriptions, a skill is found by its name alone. The skills still opened every time at 512 have names that say what they do (codex-ppt, image-to-editable-ppt, keep-codex-fast); requests for cyber-ppt all went to codex-ppt, and the four test skills last in the alphabet were never opened.
findings.item_zh: 没有描述时，skill 只能靠名字被找到。装到 512 个仍然每次都被打开的 skill，名字本身就说明用途（codex-ppt、image-to-editable-ppt、keep-codex-fast）；给 cyber-ppt 的请求全去了 codex-ppt，字母表最后的 4 个测试 skill 再也没被打开。

findings.item: Claude Code degrades differently. With the same 512 skills it kept every name and dropped most descriptions, and still opened the right skill 35 times of 36; its session started at 25,289 tokens, against 17,781 with 12 installed.
findings.item_zh: Claude Code 的退化方式不同。同样装 512 个，它保留了每个名字、去掉大部分描述，36 次里仍有 35 次打开了正确的 skill；会话起始是 25,289 个 token，装 12 个时是 17,781。

findings.item: More installed is not more capable. With every tool listed, a model chose the right one 13.62% of the time; with retrieval, 43.13%, using less than half the prompt tokens (RAG-MCP, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 装得多不等于能力强。全部列出时模型选对工具的概率是 13.62%；改用检索后是 43.13%，提示词 token 不到原来的一半（RAG-MCP，预印本）。

findings.item: Skills help when they are curated and small: +16.6 points in pass rate, and skills of at most three modules beat larger bundles (SkillsBench).
findings.item_zh: 精选的小 skill 才有帮助：通过率提高 16.6 个百分点，不超过三个模块的 skill 胜过更大的合集（SkillsBench）。

findings.item: Skills that ship scripts carry more risk: in a sample of skills from public registries, 26.1% had at least one vulnerability, and those with scripts were 2.12 times as likely to (Agent Skills in the Wild, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 带脚本的 skill 风险更高：一份来自公开市场的样本里，26.1% 的 skill 至少有一个漏洞，带脚本的出问题的概率是不带脚本的 2.12 倍（Agent Skills in the Wild，预印本）。

did.item: Installed 12 of the skills together and sent Codex and Claude Code the same 42 requests at three crowding levels (12, 112 and 512 skills installed), stopping each run when a skill was opened. Results are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 把其中 12 个 skill 一起装上，在三档拥挤度（装 12、112、512 个 skill）下给 Codex 和 Claude Code 发同样的 42 条请求，有 skill 被打开就停止。结果在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software an agent can use.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是 agent 能用的软件。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，并且每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: This tests whether a skill is found, not whether its output is any good. Each request ran once, and the requests were written from each skill's own description, which favours triggering. The two agents ran different models (gpt-6-astra and Claude Opus 5.5), so a gap between them may be the model or the agent. That the four skills never opened at 512 were among the 134 Codex left out is inferred from their names coming last in the alphabet.
not_done.item_zh: 这测的是 skill 找不找得到，不是它的产出好不好。每条请求只跑一次，而且是照各 skill 自己的描述写的，对触发有利。两个 agent 用的模型不同（gpt-6-astra 和 Claude Opus 5.5），两者的差距可能来自模型，也可能来自 agent。「装到 512 个时再没被打开的 4 个 skill 属于 Codex 丢掉的 134 个」是根据它们的名字排在字母表最后推断的。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

method.h2: How we judge Claude skills managers: what enters the context, what reaches your machine
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Claude skills 管理工具：什么进了上下文，什么到了你的机器上
method.thesis: A Claude skills manager decides two things for you. The first is what sits in your agent's context. More skills is not better: in SkillsBench (87 tasks, 18 model and agent setups) curated skills raised the pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5%, and focused skills of at most three modules beat large bundles. When every tool is put in front of a model at once, it picks the right one 13.62% of the time; retrieving only the relevant ones raised that to 43.13% and cut prompt tokens by more than half (RAG-MCP). On our own Claude Code setup, 512 skills were installed and 51 had ever been used; removing the other 461 saved 38,147 tokens in every session. The second is what code reaches your machine. A study of 98,380 skills from two registries confirmed 157 malicious ones (USENIX Security 2026), and in another sample 26.1% of skills had at least one vulnerability, with skills that ship scripts 2.12 times as likely to. So we judge a Claude skills manager by how it handles both: does it load skills on demand, and does it check what it installs.
method.thesis_zh: Claude skills 管理工具替你决定两件事。第一件是什么留在 agent 的上下文里。skill 不是越多越好：SkillsBench（87 个任务、18 种模型与 agent 组合）里，精选的 skill 把通过率从 33.9% 提到 50.5%，而且不超过三个模块的小 skill 胜过大而全的合集。把所有工具一次性摆给模型，它选对的概率只有 13.62%；只检索相关的几个，选对率升到 43.13%，提示词 token 减少一半以上（RAG-MCP）。在我们自己的 Claude Code 上，装了 512 个 skill，用过的只有 51 个；删掉另外 461 个，每个会话省下 38,147 个 token。第二件是什么代码到了你的机器上。一项覆盖两个市场 98,380 个 skill 的研究确认了 157 个恶意 skill（USENIX Security 2026）；另一份样本里 26.1% 的 skill 至少有一个漏洞，带脚本的 skill 出问题的概率是不带脚本的 2.12 倍。所以我们看一个管理工具怎么处理这两件事：是否按需加载，是否检查它装进来的东西。
h3_routes: Six kinds of Claude skills manager, two jobs
六类 Claude skills 管理工具，两件事

routes.name: Skills CLI installers
routes.how: Add, remove and update skills from the terminal, usually straight from a GitHub repo.
routes.how_zh: 在终端里添加、删除、更新 skill，通常直接从 GitHub 仓库装。
routes.gain: Fast, scriptable, and easy to remove what you no longer use.
routes.gain_zh: 快、能写进脚本，不用的也容易删。
routes.cost: Installs whatever the repo contains, scripts included, unless it shows you first.
routes.cost_zh: 除非先给你看，否则仓库里有什么就装什么，脚本也一起装。

routes.name: All-in-one managers
routes.how: One place for skills, MCP servers, rules, hooks and settings across several agents.
routes.how_zh: 一个地方管多个 agent 的 skill、MCP、规则、hooks 和设置。
routes.gain: One source of truth instead of a folder per agent.
routes.gain_zh: 一份配置管所有 agent，不用每个 agent 各存一份。
routes.cost: The more it manages, the more it can load into every session; check how it decides what to load.
routes.cost_zh: 管得越多，可能塞进每个会话的就越多；要看它怎么决定加载什么。

routes.name: Sync across agents
routes.how: Keeps one skill folder linked into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others.
routes.how_zh: 把同一个 skill 文件夹链接到 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。
routes.gain: Write a skill once, use it everywhere.
routes.gain_zh: 一个 skill 写一次，到处都能用。
routes.cost: Every agent now carries every skill; prune the folder or the cost multiplies.
routes.cost_zh: 每个 agent 都背上全部 skill；不定期清理，代价成倍增加。

routes.name: Desktop and web apps
routes.how: Browse, edit, enable and disable installed skills in a window.
routes.how_zh: 在界面里浏览、编辑、启用和停用已装的 skill。
routes.gain: You see what is installed, which is the first step to removing it.
routes.gain_zh: 能看见装了什么，这是清理的第一步。
routes.cost: Some read your agent's config folders and keys; check the grade.
routes.cost_zh: 有些会读 agent 的配置目录和密钥，先看评级。

routes.name: Registries and marketplaces
routes.how: Search and install skills others published.
routes.how_zh: 搜索并安装别人发布的 skill。
routes.gain: Discovery: the skill you need may already exist.
routes.gain_zh: 发现：你要的 skill 可能已经有人做了。
routes.cost: This is where malicious skills were found; a pattern scanner alone flags far too many, so look for one that reads the repository.
routes.cost_zh: 恶意 skill 正是在这里被发现的；只靠模式匹配的扫描会误报一大片，要找读仓库上下文的那种。

routes.name: Team management
routes.how: A shared, often self-hosted registry with versions, reviews and permissions.
routes.how_zh: 共享的、常可自托管的 skill 仓库，带版本、审核和权限。
routes.gain: A review step before a skill reaches everyone's machine.
routes.gain_zh: skill 到每个人机器之前有一道审核。
routes.cost: Only as good as the review; someone has to read what is published.
routes.cost_zh: 效果取决于审核，总得有人读发布上来的东西。

method.gap: The studies measure skills and registries, not the managers themselves. No paper yet tests whether a manager's on-demand loading actually keeps the context small, so the questions below are our reading of the research, not its findings.
method.gap_zh: 这些研究测的是 skill 和市场，不是管理工具本身。还没有论文测过管理工具的按需加载是否真能让上下文变小，所以下面的问题是我们对研究的解读，不是研究的结论。

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every Claude skills manager
每个 Claude skills 管理工具我们问四个问题

questions.q: Context: does it load skills on demand, or put every installed skill in front of the agent?
questions.q_zh: 上下文：按需加载 skill，还是把装过的全部摆给 agent？

questions.q: Pruning: does it show what you have installed and help you remove what you do not use?
questions.q_zh: 清理：能否看清装了什么，并帮你删掉不用的？

questions.q: Source: before installing, does it show where a skill comes from and which scripts it will run?
questions.q_zh: 来源：安装前是否说明 skill 从哪来、会执行哪些脚本？

questions.q: Checks with context: if it scans for risk, does it read the repository, or only match patterns in the skill file?
questions.q_zh: 带上下文的检查：如果它做安全扫描，是读整个仓库，还是只在 skill 文件里匹配关键词？

floor_activity: while they install, sync or manage skills
安装、同步、管理 skill 时的行为
h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: Only one of 14 tools stopped at a risky skill. Asked to install a skill that ships a curl | sh setup script, asm flagged it as high risk and declined by default; skillshare warned and installed it; the other twelve installed it, seven showing only where it came from and five without a word.
findings.item_zh: 14 个工具里只有 1 个在风险 skill 面前停下。让它们安装一个带 curl | sh 安装脚本的 skill：asm 标为高风险、默认不装；skillshare 发了警告但照装；其余 12 个都装了，7 个只显示来源，5 个一声不吭。

findings.item: Context cost did not separate them. With 20 skills installed, Claude Code loaded 345 to 396 more tokens per session than the 21,137 it loads with none, whatever tool installed them, and no tool touched CLAUDE.md or registered an MCP server. Claude Code already loads skills on demand; the tools differ in what they check and what they can undo.
findings.item_zh: 上下文成本没有拉开差距。装了 20 个 skill 后，Claude Code 每次会话比空装时的 21,137 多加载 345 到 396 个 token，用哪个工具装都一样；没有一个工具改 CLAUDE.md 或注册 MCP 服务。Claude Code 本来就按需加载 skill；工具之间的差别在于检查了什么、能撤回什么。

findings.item: Removing is not a given. Twelve of 14 removed everything except the five skills still needed; skillfile's remove only edits its manifest and leaves the folders, and agent-skill-sync never deletes by design.
findings.item_zh: 能删不是理所当然。14 个里有 12 个把不需要的都删掉、只留下要用的 5 个；skillfile 的 remove 只改清单、不删文件夹，agent-skill-sync 按设计从不删除。

findings.item: Fewer, focused skills work better. Curated skills raised the average pass rate by 16.6 points across 18 setups, and focused skills of at most three modules beat large bundles (SkillsBench).
findings.item_zh: 少而精更好用。在 18 种组合上，精选 skill 让平均通过率提高 16.6 个百分点，不超过三个模块的小 skill 胜过大而全的合集（SkillsBench）。

findings.item: Loading everything costs accuracy, not only tokens: retrieving the relevant tools instead of listing all of them took selection accuracy from 13.62% to 43.13% (RAG-MCP, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 全部加载的代价不只是 token，还有准确率：只检索相关工具而不是全部列出，选对率从 13.62% 升到 43.13%（RAG-MCP，预印本）。

findings.item: Malicious skills exist in the registries: 157 confirmed among 98,380, carrying 632 vulnerabilities across 13 attack techniques, over half from a single actor; all were removed after disclosure (USENIX Security 2026).
findings.item_zh: 市场里确有恶意 skill：98,380 个里确认 157 个，涉及 13 种攻击手法、632 个漏洞，一半以上出自同一个攻击者；披露后全部下架（USENIX Security 2026）。

findings.item: Scanners overreach without context. Marketplace scanners flagged up to 46.8% of skills as malicious; reading the surrounding repository left 0.52% suspicious (best paper, AgentSkills '26). We found the same with our own grading: rules that matched words, not behaviour, were wrong on every hit and were removed.
findings.item_zh: 不看上下文的扫描会误报：市场自带的扫描器把最多 46.8% 的 skill 标成恶意，结合所在仓库复核后只剩 0.52% 可疑（AgentSkills '26 最佳论文）。我们自己的评级也踩过同样的坑：只匹配字眼、不看行为的规则命中全是误报，已经删掉。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, does it manage skills rather than ship them.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、是管理 skill 还是本身就是 skill。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六类之一，可以筛选。

method.h2: How we judge humanizer skills: the two-layer method
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评去 AI 味 skill：两层法
method.thesis: AI-written text gives itself away on two layers. The surface is word choice and punctuation: "delve", "tapestry", em-dashes, stock phrases. Underneath are the choices: spelling out the lesson, tying every thread up neatly, gesturing at "great works" instead of naming one. Most humanizer skills scrub the surface. A 2026 study of 61,608 stories (StoryScope, University of Maryland and Google DeepMind, COLM 2026) found that this barely matters: after a rewriting tool removed surface artifacts from AI stories, a classifier that looks only at narrative structure still caught 93.9% of them, against 95.5% before. So we judge a humanizer by which layer it reaches.
method.thesis_zh: AI 写的文字会在两层露馅。表层是用词和标点："delve""tapestry"、破折号、套话。下面一层是写作上的选择：把道理讲穿、把每条线都收得整整齐齐、泛泛提一句"经典作品"而不点名。大多数去 AI 味 skill 只擦表层。2026 年一项覆盖 61,608 篇小说的研究（StoryScope，马里兰大学与 Google DeepMind，COLM 2026）发现，这几乎没用：用改写工具去掉 AI 小说的表层痕迹之后，一个只看叙事结构的分类器仍然识别出 93.9%，改写前是 95.5%。所以我们按一个 skill 改到哪一层来评它。
h3_routes: Three layers of AI tells
AI 痕迹的三层
columns: 只改这一层会留下什么

routes.name: Words and punctuation
routes.how: "delve", "tapestry", em-dashes, stock openers and closers.
routes.how_zh: "delve""tapestry"、破折号、固定的开头和结尾套话。
routes.gain: Fading on its own: newer models use far fewer em-dashes, and fine-tuning on human style cut AI detection on creative writing from 97% to 3%.
routes.gain_zh: 本身就在消失：新模型的破折号已大幅减少；用人类文风微调后，创意写作的 AI 检出率从 97% 降到 3%。
routes.cost: Easy to fix and easy to fake; fixing it changes nothing else.
routes.cost_zh: 好改也好装；改了它，别的都没变。

routes.name: Phrasing
routes.how: Clichés, purple prose, redundant exposition.
routes.how_zh: 陈词滥调、辞藻堆砌、重复解释。
routes.gain: In the study, a tool rewrote seven kinds of such artifacts; structure-based detection fell only from 95.5% to 93.9%.
routes.gain_zh: 研究里用工具改写了七类这样的痕迹，基于结构的识别率只从 95.5% 降到 93.9%。
routes.cost: The text reads smoother but makes the same choices.
routes.cost_zh: 读起来更顺，但做的还是同样的选择。

routes.name: Structure
routes.how: States its own theme (77% of AI stories vs 52% of human ones), resolves into acceptance (47% vs 27%), no subplots (79% vs 57%), emotion through bodily sensation (81% vs 38%), vague allusions instead of named works (72% vs 50%), rarely addresses the reader (7% vs 28%).
routes.how_zh: 直接点明主题（AI 77%，人类 52%）、以接受与和解收尾（47% 对 27%）、没有支线（79% 对 57%）、用身体感受写情绪（81% 对 38%）、泛泛提及而不点名具体作品（72% 对 50%）、几乎不对读者说话（7% 对 28%）。
routes.gain: Narrative choices alone separate human from AI fiction at 93.2% macro-F1, with every style signal removed.
routes.gain_zh: 去掉所有文风信号，只靠叙事选择就能以 93.2% 的 macro-F1 区分人写和 AI 写的小说。
routes.cost: This is the layer that persists. Changing it takes a real rewrite: drop the stated moral, leave an ending open, name the specific thing.
routes.cost_zh: 这一层才会留下来。要改它得真改写：删掉讲出来的道理、让结尾留白、把泛指换成具体的名字。

method.gap: The study measured fiction. For posts, emails, reports and docs we apply the same split as a working rule: we have not measured it on non-fiction. The page also lists code and UI tools; there the surface is comment bloat or a default gradient and the structure is what the code or the screen actually does, which is our analogy, not the study's.
method.gap_zh: 这项研究测的是小说。对帖子、邮件、报告和文档，我们把同样的分层当作工作规则来用，但没有在非虚构文本上测过。这一页还收了代码和界面类工具：那里的表层是冗余注释或默认渐变，结构是代码或界面实际做了什么。这是我们的类比，不是研究的结论。

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every humanizer
每个去 AI 味 skill 我们问四个问题

questions.q: Layer: does it only swap words and punctuation, or does it change phrasing and structure?
questions.q_zh: 层次：只换词换标点，还是会改措辞和结构？

questions.q: Meaning: does it keep facts, numbers and names exactly as they were?
questions.q_zh: 意思：事实、数字、名字是否原样保留？

questions.q: Specificity: does it push toward concrete, named details instead of vague gestures?
questions.q_zh: 具体：是否把泛泛的说法换成具体的、点得出名字的细节？

questions.q: Evidence: does it show what it changed and why (a diff, a report), so you can check it?
questions.q_zh: 证据：是否说明改了什么、为什么改（对照、报告），让你能核对？

floor_activity: while they rewrite or check text, code or UI

did.item: On 2026-10-07 we set out to run 26 of them end to end, and 23 ran: each was installed in a throwaway sandbox and used by Claude Code on the same three texts (an English post, a Chinese post, a short story), asked to make them read as human-written and keep every fact. A judge model (gpt-6-astra) compared each rewrite with its original on the study's structure features; we read every low or odd score ourselves. did.item_zh: 2026-10-07 我们计划端到端实跑其中 26 个，实际跑成 23 个：每个装进一个用完即删的沙箱，由 Claude Code 调用它处理同样的三份文本（一篇英文文章、一篇中文文章、一篇短篇小说），要求改得像人写的、事实一个不丢。评审模型（gpt-6-astra）按研究里的结构特征逐份对比原文和改写；每个偏低或反常的分数我们都亲自读过。每张卡片都链到改写前后的对照。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则对每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item_zh: 我们只跑了一组三份文本，都由同一个模型写成；换一份文本或换人工编辑来评，排名可能不同。评审也是模型，所以请看改写前后对照，不要只看分数。

not_done.item: This page is not a guide to passing AI detectors. A humanizer that only scrubs the surface will not hide AI authorship from a structure-based check, per the study above.
not_done.item_zh: 这一页不是教你绕过 AI 检测。按上面的研究，只擦表层的 humanizer 骗不过基于结构的检测。

author.name: Jason Zhu
author.role: Builds and maintains Agent Skills Hub and the awesome-humanizer-skills list; tracking open-source agent skills since 2024; author of the Blue Book of Agent Skills 2026.
author.role_zh: Agent Skills Hub 和 awesome-humanizer-skills 合集的作者与维护者；2024 年起追踪开源 agent skill；《Agent Skills 蓝皮书 2026》作者。

findings.item: None of them rewrote the structure away. Across 40 rewrites, the stated lesson survived 26 of 26 times, the tidy ending 28 of 28, the single track 40 of 40; only addressing the reader changed, in 6. 19 of 21 rewriters changed wording, not structure, which is the layer the study found barely matters.
findings.item_zh: 没有一个把结构上的 AI 味改掉。40 份改写里，讲明的道理 26/26 留着，整齐的结尾 28/28 留着，单线论证 40/40 没动；唯一有变化的是对读者说话，6 份。21 个改写类里 19 个只改了措辞没改结构，而研究发现这一层几乎不起作用。

findings.item: The surface is the easy part: 12 of 15 cleared every em-dash from the English post. Changing the structure is not the same as fixing it: sepia restructured the Chinese post into a numbered list with a firmer summary, which is more AI-like, and AI-Text-Humanizer-App prepended stock transitions ("Nonetheless, Every morning").
findings.item_zh: 表层最容易：15 个里有 12 个把英文文章的破折号清零。改了结构不等于改对了：sepia 把中文文章改成编号清单、总结更重，反而更像 AI；AI-Text-Humanizer-App 在句首硬加连接词（"Nonetheless, Every morning"）。

findings.item: No rewrite lost a fact: every number in the two posts survived, including in Traditional Chinese. Stars do not predict results: the best-reading rewrites came from sloptrim (212 stars) and anti-slop; blader/humanizer, with 54,000 stars, scored in the middle.
findings.item_zh: 没有一份改丢事实：两篇文章里的数字全部保留，改成繁体的也一样。星数预测不了结果：读起来最像人写的来自 sloptrim（212 星）和 anti-slop；5.4 万星的 blader/humanizer 在中游。

findings.item: Of the five detectors, only humanizer-skill flags structure in earnest (8 of its 38 flags); avoid-ai-writing flagged none. Three could not run, and each said why: AIWriteX writes new articles rather than rewriting one, attention-span changes Claude's own replies and starts only by hand, and humanize-text needs a Niutrans key. Two that need their own LLM key, patina and StealthHumanizer, ran with ours (gpt-6-astra).
findings.item_zh: 五个检测类里，只有 humanizer-skill 认真查结构（38 处里 8 处）；avoid-ai-writing 一处都没报。三个跑不了，都说明了原因：AIWriteX 是写新文章而不是改写、attention-span 改的是 Claude 自己的回话且只能手动启动、humanize-text 要 Niutrans 的 key。patina 和 StealthHumanizer 需要自配 LLM key，用的是我们的（gpt-6-astra）。

extra_faq.q: What is unslop?
extra_faq.a: unslop is not one tool: more than a dozen open-source agent skills share the name, and they split by what they clean up. Interfaces: heydamir/unslop, which took off in late October 2026, redesigns vibecoded, AI-looking UI; 0design/unslop-skill audits a design your agent generated; felipebasurto/unslop-ui fixes interface and chart copy. Writing: theclaymethod/unslop, MohamedAbdallah-14/unslop, asavvin-pixel/unslop, badmuriss/unslop and woerndl/unsloppify remove AI writing tells. mshumer/unslop finds the defaults a model keeps falling back on and turns them into an instruction file. They share a name, not an author or a method, so check which one you mean before you install it.
extra_faq.qZh: unslop 是什么?
extra_faq.aZh: unslop 不是某一个工具:十几个开源 agent skill 都叫这个名字,按清理的对象分几类。界面:heydamir/unslop(2026 年 10 月底走红)把 AI 味很重的界面重新设计得有自己的风格;0design/unslop-skill 检查 agent 生成的设计;felipebasurto/unslop-ui 改界面和图表里的文案。文字:theclaymethod/unslop、MohamedAbdallah-14/unslop、asavvin-pixel/unslop、badmuriss/unslop 和 woerndl/unsloppify 去掉写作里的 AI 痕迹。mshumer/unslop 则找出模型反复使用的套路,写成一份指令文件。它们只是同名,作者和做法都不同,安装前先确认你要的是哪一个。

extra_faq.q: What is the humanizer skill for Claude?
extra_faq.a: blader/humanizer is an agent skill that finds and removes signs of AI-generated writing from text; op7418/Humanizer-zh is its Chinese version. Related skills apply the same idea elsewhere: hardikpandya/stop-slop for prose rules, Leonxlnx/taste-skill and Nutlope/hallmark for UI design, peteromallet/desloppify for code.
extra_faq.qZh: Claude 的 humanizer skill 是什么?
extra_faq.aZh: blader/humanizer 是一个找出并去掉文字中 AI 写作痕迹的 agent skill,op7418/Humanizer-zh 是它的中文版。同样的思路也用在别处:hardikpandya/stop-slop 是写作规则,Leonxlnx/taste-skill 和 Nutlope/hallmark 针对界面设计,peteromallet/desloppify 针对代码。

extra_faq.q: How do I use a humanizer skill in Claude Code or Codex?
extra_faq.a: Install the skill folder (it contains a SKILL.md) into the agent's skills directory, then ask the agent to humanize or de-slop a piece of text; the skill supplies the patterns to look for and the rewrite rules. Every humanizer on this page is in the open-source list zhuyansen/awesome-humanizer-skills on GitHub, with its security grade.
extra_faq.qZh: 怎么在 Claude Code 或 Codex 里用 humanizer skill?
extra_faq.aZh: 把 skill 文件夹(含 SKILL.md)装进 agent 的 skills 目录,然后让 agent 给一段文字去 AI 味;skill 会提供要找的痕迹和改写规则。本页的所有 humanizer 也收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-humanizer-skills 里,附安全评级。

method.h2: How we judge Claude design skills: right, and not the same as everyone else's
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Claude 设计 skill：做得对，而且不和别人长得一样
method.thesis: A Claude design skill has two jobs. The first is getting the interface right. On Design2Code, 484 real web pages rebuilt from screenshots, models mostly fail at recalling the visual elements and at getting the layout right (NAACL 2025), so what a skill adds is structure: a design system, spacing and type rules, a step that looks at the rendered page. The second job is not looking like everyone else's. In a controlled experiment, writers given ideas by a language model wrote stories rated more creative and better written, yet the stories were more similar to each other than those written without it (Science Advances 2024); a second study found the same for ideas across users (C&C 2024). Those studies measured stories and ideas, not interfaces, but the default purple-gradient look of AI-made UI is the same effect, and it is what the most-starred skills on this page set out to stop. Both jobs can be tested: render the page, take screenshots and score them against a checklist, which matched human rankings 94.4% of the time on ArtifactsBench. So we judge a design skill by whether it gives the agent rules and a way to see its own output, and by whether it pushes away from the default.
method.thesis_zh: Claude 设计 skill 有两件事要做。第一件是把界面做对。在 Design2Code（从截图重建 484 个真实网页）上，模型主要错在两处：漏掉视觉元素、布局不对（NAACL 2025）。所以 skill 能补的是结构：一套设计系统、间距和字体规则、一个看渲染结果的步骤。第二件是别和所有人长得一样。一项对照实验里，拿到语言模型点子的作者写出的故事被评为更有创意、文笔更好，但彼此之间比不用 AI 的故事更相似（Science Advances 2024）；另一项研究发现不同用户的点子也会趋同（C&C 2024）。这两项测的是故事和点子，不是界面，但 AI 做的界面千篇一律的紫色渐变就是同一种效应，也正是这页星数最高的几个 skill 要解决的问题。两件事都能测：渲染页面、截图、按清单打分，在 ArtifactsBench 上这种方法和人工排名的一致率达到 94.4%。所以我们看一个设计 skill：是否给 agent 规则和看见自己产出的办法，是否把它推离默认样式。

questions.q_zh: 远离默认：会不会把界面推离人人都有的样子，并允许你定自己的方向？

questions.q: Fidelity: when it works from a design or a screenshot, does it keep every element and the layout?
questions.q_zh: 还原度：照设计稿或截图做的时候，元素和布局都保留了吗？

floor_activity: while they design or generate UI
设计或生成界面时的行为
h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: The old AI look is gone, with or without a skill: of 22 pages built from one brief, none had a purple accent, gradient text, emoji icons or a centred hero.
findings.item_zh: 老式的 AI 味已经没有了，装不装 skill 都一样：按同一份需求做出的 22 个页面里，没有一个用了紫色强调色、渐变文字、emoji 图标或居中大标题。

findings.item: There is a new default, and some skills do not move it. Claude Code alone chose a serif headline, teal and cream both times; 2 of 10 skills matched it on headline font, body font, accent and background, and 4 shared one or none. This is the homogenisation Doshi and Hauser measured in writing, seen in pages.
findings.item_zh: 新的默认风格已经出现，有些 skill 改变不了它。Claude Code 自己两次都选了衬线标题、青绿和米白；10 个 skill 里有 2 个在标题字体、正文字体、强调色和背景上与它完全一致，4 个只有一项或零项相同。这就是 Doshi 和 Hauser 在写作上测到的同质化，出现在了页面上。

findings.item: The basics are not what separates design skills: every one passed at least 6.5 of 7 checks (copy complete, nothing invented, one h1, button on the first screen, no sideways scroll on a phone, no errors, self-contained).
findings.item_zh: 基本功不是拉开差距的地方：每个 skill 在 7 项检查里至少通过 6.5 项（文案完整、没有编造内容、只有一个 h1、首屏有按钮、手机上不横向滚动、没有错误、自包含）。

findings.item: Models rebuilding 484 real web pages from screenshots mostly failed at two things: recalling the visual elements and producing the right layout (Design2Code, NAACL 2025).
findings.item_zh: 模型从截图重建 484 个真实网页，主要错在两处：漏掉视觉元素、布局不对（Design2Code，NAACL 2025）。

findings.item: Generative AI made each writer's work better and everyone's work more alike: stories written with AI ideas were rated more creative, yet were more similar to each other (Science Advances 2024); ideas across users converged the same way (C&C 2024).
findings.item_zh: 生成式 AI 让每个人的作品更好，也让所有人的作品更像：用 AI 点子写的故事被评为更有创意，但彼此更相似（Science Advances 2024）；不同用户的点子也同样趋同（C&C 2024）。

findings.item: UI quality can be scored automatically: rendering the output, taking screenshots and judging them against a per-task checklist agreed with WebDev Arena's rankings 94.4% of the time, across 1,825 tasks (ArtifactsBench, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 界面质量可以自动打分：渲染、截图、按逐题清单评，在 1,825 个任务上和 WebDev Arena 的排名一致率 94.4%（ArtifactsBench，预印本）。

findings.item: Design critique needs real designers' examples: 3,059 critiques of 983 mobile UIs by seven experienced designers improved a model's UI feedback by 55% (UICrit, UIST 2024).
findings.item_zh: 设计评审需要真实设计师的示例：七位资深设计师对 983 个移动界面写的 3,059 条评审，让模型的界面反馈提升 55%（UICrit，UIST 2024）。

did.item: Had 10 of the skills build the same landing page twice in a throwaway sandbox, with Claude Code and no skill as the control, and measured every page in a browser. Results and pictures are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 让其中 10 个 skill 在用完即删的沙箱里把同一个落地页各做两遍，用不装 skill 的 Claude Code 做对照，并在浏览器里测量每个页面。结果和截图在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, what part of design does it handle.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、管设计的哪一环。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: We count sameness and basics, not taste: no one rated these pages for beauty, and a page can differ from the default and still be worse. One brief (a consumer landing page), two builds per skill, still pages only, so motion and interaction are not measured. The subject may pull every design toward water colours.
not_done.item_zh: 我们数的是「像不像」和基本功，不是审美：没有人给这些页面的美观程度打分，和默认风格不同的页面也可能更差。只有一份需求（面向消费者的落地页），每个 skill 两次产出，只看静态页面，所以动效和交互没有测。题材本身也可能把所有设计都拉向水的颜色。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the skill run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察 skill 运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

what.text: A PPT skill is an installable package of instructions, templates and scripts (usually a folder with a SKILL.md file) that teaches a coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex to turn a prompt or a document into a slide deck. PPT skills differ most in what they hand you at the end: a native .pptx you can keep editing in PowerPoint, HTML slides you present from a browser, or slides drawn as images whose text cannot be changed.
what.text_zh: PPT skill 是一个可以安装的指令、模板和脚本包（通常是一个带 SKILL.md 的文件夹），让 Claude Code、Codex 这类编程 agent 学会把一句话或一份文档做成幻灯片。不同 PPT skill 最大的区别在于最后交给你什么：能在 PowerPoint 里继续改的原生 .pptx、在浏览器里放映的 HTML 幻灯片，还是整页画成图片、文字改不了的幻灯片。

items.line: The fastest good deck. Browser slides built with the agent's frontend skills: 100% on the rubric in about six minutes. The text can be edited only in the HTML (L1).

method.h2: How we judge PPT skills: the delivery-chain method
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 PPT skill：交付链方法
method.thesis: A deck is finished when you hand it over, not when the agent writes the last slide. The best PPT skill is the one that leaves you the least rework before that point. GitHub stars measure how good a skill looks and how far it spreads; they do not measure how much work it saves you, so we read what each skill actually produces before we rank it.
method.thesis_zh: 一份 deck 不是 agent 写完最后一页就算完成，而是交出去才算完成。最好的 PPT skill，是在交出去之前留给你返工最少的那一个。GitHub 星数衡量的是一个 skill 看起来多好、传得多广，衡量不了它帮你省了多少事，所以我们先读懂每个 skill 实际产出什么，再排序。

routes.name: Native PPTX
routes.how: The agent writes the PowerPoint file itself, object by object.
routes.how_zh: agent 直接写 PowerPoint 文件，一个对象一个对象地放。
routes.gain: Every word stays editable in PowerPoint, Keynote or WPS, so a colleague can pick it up.
routes.gain_zh: 每个字都能在 PowerPoint、Keynote、WPS 里改，同事能接着改。
routes.cost: Layouts are limited to what code can place; decks tend to look plainer.
routes.cost_zh: 版式受限于代码能摆出来的样子，往往偏朴素。

routes.name: Web slides
routes.how: The agent writes HTML and CSS, and you present from the browser.
routes.how_zh: agent 写 HTML 和 CSS，你在浏览器里放映。
routes.gain: The most design freedom and animation; the most-starred PPT skills are on this route.
routes.gain_zh: 设计自由度和动画最强；星数最高的 PPT skill 都在这条路线上。
routes.cost: Turning it into a .pptx loses fidelity.
routes.cost_zh: 转成 .pptx 会走样。

routes.name: Image-first
routes.how: An image model paints each slide.
routes.how_zh: 由图像模型逐页画出来。
routes.gain: The most striking visuals.
routes.gain_zh: 视觉最惊艳。
routes.cost: The text is pixels: you cannot fix a typo without redrawing the slide.
routes.cost_zh: 字是像素：错一个字就得重画整页。

method.gap: The two routes that look best cannot hand over an editable .pptx, and most people still have to. That gap is where this field is moving: converters that turn slide images back into editable PowerPoint (image-to-editable-ppt-skill), generators that draw a deck first and rebuild it as PPTX (GordenSuperPPTSkills), and pipelines that take a document straight to native slides (ppt-master). Documents-to-slides tools and all-in-one frameworks sit outside the three routes, so the counts above do not add up to the whole page.
method.gap_zh: 最好看的两条路线交不出可编辑的 .pptx，而大多数人最后还是得交 .pptx。这道鸿沟正是这个领域在往前走的方向：把幻灯片图片转回可编辑 PowerPoint 的转换器（image-to-editable-ppt-skill）、先画图再重建成 PPTX 的生成器（GordenSuperPPTSkills），以及从文档直接生成原生幻灯片的流水线（ppt-master）。文档转幻灯片的工具和综合框架不属于这三条路线，所以上表的数字加起来不等于整页。

questions.q: Story: does it plan the storyline (an outline, SCQA, a pyramid) before it draws anything?
questions.q_zh: 叙事：动手画之前，会不会先排故事线（大纲、SCQA、金字塔）？

questions.q: Layout system: does it ship fixed templates or a theme system, so slide 12 matches slide 2?
questions.q_zh: 版式：有没有固定模板或主题体系，保证第 12 页和第 2 页风格一致？

questions.q: Editability: is the output native and editable, editable in the browser, or a picture?
questions.q_zh: 可改：交付物是原生可编辑、浏览器里可改，还是一张图？

questions.q: Self-check: does it render its own output and fix what it sees? PPTAgent, for one, renders the slides, has a vision model review the images, and revises.
questions.q_zh: 自检：会不会把自己的产出渲染出来、看到问题自己改？比如 PPTAgent 会把幻灯片渲染出来，交给视觉模型看图审查，再修改。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count, not only popular repos) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, what does it produce.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数，不只看热门仓库）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、产出什么。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of six types, so you can filter by route.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入六种类型之一，你可以按路线筛选。

did.item: On 2026-10-07 we set out to run 31 of them end to end, and 27 ran: each was installed in a throwaway sandbox and used by Claude Code to build the same 8-10 slide brief. Each deck gets three results. Rework before handing it over, our own measure. Editability, a level from L0 (nothing editable) to L5 (animated), parsed from the file after SlidesGen-Bench's PEI. And a content rubric of 30 yes/no items after PresentBench (fundamentals, design, completeness, correctness, fidelity to the brief), which a vision model (gpt-6-astra) answered three times per deck, keeping the majority; we read every "no" ourselves and overturned 7 of 35, with the reasons published.
did.item_zh: 2026-10-07 我们计划端到端实跑其中 31 个，实际跑成 27 个：每个装进一个用完即删的沙箱，由 Claude Code 调用它做同一份 8–10 页的测试题。每份 deck 给三个结果：交付前要返工多少，这是我们自己的指标；可编辑性，按 SlidesGen-Bench 的 PEI 从 L0（不可编辑）到 L5（带动画）分级，直接解析文件得出；内容检查单，按 PresentBench 的做法写 30 道是/否题（基本功、设计、完整、正确、忠于测试题），视觉模型（gpt-6-astra）每份答三遍取多数；每个"否"我们都亲自看过，35 个里改判 7 个，理由公开。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则对每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: The other entries on this page have not been run yet; for them, the routes and questions above come from reading what each one says it produces. The test brief and the full results are public.
not_done.item_zh: 本页其余条目还没有实跑；对它们来说，上面的路线和问题来自读每个 skill 自己写明的产出。测试题和完整结果都公开。

not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

findings.item: Content was not where the decks differed. On the 30-item rubric, 10 of 26 decks scored 100% and the lowest 89%; completeness and correctness each fell short on a single deck. The points went on takeaway titles (8 decks used topic labels such as "The problem"), text too small or too faint (5 each), and invented details (5 decks); one went online and added a repository count that is not in the brief.
findings.item_zh: 内容不是拉开差距的地方。30 道题的检查单上，26 份 deck 里有 10 份满分，最低 89%；"完整"和"正确"各只有一份没拿满。扣分集中在三处：标题是不是一句结论（8 份用的是"问题"这类话题标签）、字太小或太淡（各 5 份）、编造细节（5 份）；有一份还自己上网，加了测试题里没有的仓库数。

findings.item: Rework follows editability, not looks or content. Both decks that need substantial rework are L0, all images: their content rubric scores (93% and 96%) are as good as the rest. One of the best-looking decks (rw-consulting-ppt) scored 100% on content and still needs a round of edits, because none of its text can be changed.
findings.item_zh: 返工多少跟着"能不能改"走，不跟着好看或内容走。要大改的两份都是 L0、整页图片，它们的内容检查单（93% 和 96%）和别人一样好。视觉上最好的之一 rw-consulting-ppt 内容满分，仍要改一轮，因为一个字都改不了。

findings.item: Stars do not predict results. One of the two best decks came from a skill with 900 stars (ppt-agent-skills); ppt-master, with 57,800, needed only touch-ups.
findings.item_zh: 星数预测不了结果。两份最好的 deck 里有一份来自只有 900 星的 ppt-agent-skills；5.78 万星的 ppt-master 也只要小修。

findings.item: Four could not run, and each stopped and said why rather than faking a deck: the repo was emptied by its author (now removed from this page), Codex only, a standalone app with its own model key, a Gemini key. The converter image-to-editable-ppt-skill, given another skill's all-image deck, rebuilt it with 2,224 editable characters and 78 separate icons, nearly identical to the original.
findings.item_zh: 有 4 个跑不了，每个都停下来说明原因，没有拿别的办法凑一份：仓库被作者清空（已从本页移除）、只能在 Codex 里用、要自配模型 key 的独立应用、需要 Gemini 的 key。转换器 image-to-editable-ppt-skill 拿到另一个 skill 做的纯图片 deck，还原出 2,224 字可编辑文字和 78 个独立图标，和原图几乎一样。

method.h2: How we judge Obsidian MCP servers, skills and plugins: as the agent's memory
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Obsidian MCP、skill 和插件：把它当作 agent 的记忆来评
method.thesis: Once Claude can read and write your Obsidian vault, the vault is the agent's long-term memory, so we judge an Obsidian MCP server, skill or plugin the way memory is judged. LongMemEval (ICLR 2025) tests five abilities with 500 questions: finding a fact, reasoning across sessions, reasoning about time, keeping up with updates, and abstaining when the answer is not there. Commercial assistants and long-context models lost 30% of their accuracy over sustained interactions, and the paper splits a memory system into three stages: indexing, retrieval and reading. On LoCoMo (ACL 2024), conversations of about 600 turns over up to 32 sessions, models with long contexts or retrieval still lag far behind people. Plain files are not the weak point: an agent that kept the conversations in a file and searched them with grep-style tools scored 74.0% on LoCoMo, above the 68.5% Mem0 reported (Letta, a benchmark write-up, not a paper). Markdown notes, which is what Obsidian stores, can hold a memory well; what decides the result is how the agent finds what it needs and keeps it current.
method.thesis_zh: 一旦 Claude 能读写你的 Obsidian 笔记库，这个库就成了 agent 的长期记忆，所以我们按评记忆的方式来评 Obsidian MCP、skill 和插件。LongMemEval（ICLR 2025）用 500 道题测五种能力：找出一个事实、跨会话推理、时间推理、跟上信息更新、答案不在时拒答。商用助手和长上下文模型在持续对话中准确率下降 30%；论文把记忆系统拆成三步：建索引、检索、阅读。在 LoCoMo（ACL 2024，每段对话约 600 轮、最多 32 个会话）上，用了长上下文或检索的模型仍远不如人。纯文件并不是短板：把对话存进文件、用 grep 一类工具搜索的 agent，在 LoCoMo 上拿到 74.0%，高于 Mem0 自报的 68.5%（Letta 的评测文章，不是论文）。Obsidian 存的正是 Markdown 笔记，完全可以当记忆用；决定效果的是 agent 怎么找到需要的东西、怎么让它保持最新。
h3_routes: Five kinds of Obsidian MCP, skills and AI plugins
五类 Obsidian MCP、skill 与 AI 插件

routes.name: Obsidian MCP servers
routes.how: Expose the vault to Claude as tools: search, read, create and edit notes.
routes.how_zh: 把笔记库以工具的形式交给 Claude：搜索、读取、新建、编辑笔记。
routes.gain: Retrieval and writing: the agent asks for what it needs.
routes.gain_zh: 检索和写入：agent 需要什么就去取什么。
routes.cost: Write access to every note; check the grade and whether it can delete.
routes.cost_zh: 对每条笔记都有写权限；看评级，看它能不能删笔记。

routes.name: Obsidian skills
routes.how: Teach the agent your vault's formats and conventions: links, properties, the CLI.
routes.how_zh: 教 agent 你笔记库的格式和约定：双链、属性、命令行。
routes.gain: Reading: the agent understands what it finds.
routes.gain_zh: 阅读：agent 看得懂它找到的东西。
routes.cost: A skill describes; it does not index. Pair it with search.
routes.cost_zh: skill 只负责说明，不建索引，要和搜索配合。

routes.name: Obsidian AI plugins
routes.how: Run Claude, Codex or other agents inside Obsidian.
routes.how_zh: 在 Obsidian 里直接运行 Claude、Codex 等 agent。
routes.gain: The agent works where you write, on the open note.
routes.gain_zh: agent 就在你写字的地方，针对当前笔记工作。
routes.cost: A plugin runs with Obsidian's access to your files; install from sources you trust.
routes.cost_zh: 插件拥有 Obsidian 对你文件的访问权限，只装可信来源的。

routes.name: Second brain workflows
routes.how: Ready-made vault structures where the agent files, links and summarises what you drop in.
routes.how_zh: 现成的笔记库结构：你丢进去，agent 负责归档、加链接、写摘要。
routes.gain: Indexing and updates: notes stay organised as they grow.
routes.gain_zh: 建索引和更新：笔记越多越有条理。
routes.cost: The agent rewrites your notes; keep the vault in git so you can see and undo changes.
routes.cost_zh: agent 会改写你的笔记；把笔记库放进 git，改了什么看得见、能撤回。

routes.name: Import, publish and sync
routes.how: Bring web pages, chats and documents into the vault, or publish it out.
routes.how_zh: 把网页、对话、文档导入笔记库，或把笔记库发布出去。
routes.gain: More of what you know ends up where the agent can find it.
routes.gain_zh: 你知道的东西更多地进到 agent 找得到的地方。
routes.cost: Imports add volume, not order; the more you import, the more retrieval matters.
routes.cost_zh: 导入只增加数量，不增加条理；导得越多，检索越要紧。

method.gap: The benchmarks measure memory in long chat histories, not in a personal vault of notes, and none tests the tools listed here. Using their five abilities and three stages on a vault is our adaptation.
method.gap_zh: 这些基准测的是长对话里的记忆，不是个人笔记库，也没有测过这页列出的工具。把它们的五种能力和三个步骤用到笔记库上，是我们的改编。

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every Obsidian MCP, skill or plugin
每个 Obsidian MCP、skill 或插件我们问四个问题

questions.q: Retrieval: does it search the vault, or load whole notes into the context?
questions.q_zh: 检索：是搜索笔记库，还是把整篇笔记塞进上下文？

questions.q: Updates: when a fact changes, does the agent find and use the newer note?

h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: On a 560-note vault no tool answered better than plain file tools. All 5 tools that ran got 15 of 15, and so did Claude Code with nothing installed, including the three questions the vault cannot answer. This matches Letta's result that an agent with a filesystem does well on memory benchmarks.
findings.item_zh: 在 560 条笔记的库上，没有工具比普通文件工具答得更好。跑成的 5 个工具都是 15 题全对，什么都不装的 Claude Code 也一样，包括库里答不出的 3 题。这和 Letta 的结论一致：有文件系统可用的 agent 在记忆基准上表现就很好。

findings.item: The tools cost 1.7 to 6.1 times the tokens of the control for the same answers; the most expensive returned long search results.
findings.item_zh: 同样的答案，工具消耗的 token 是对照组的 1.7 到 6.1 倍；最贵的那个返回的搜索结果很长。

findings.item: 3 of 10 tools, the most-starred MCP server among them, only work through the Local REST API plugin of a running Obsidian app.
findings.item_zh: 10 个工具里有 3 个（包括星数最高的 MCP 服务）只能通过正在运行的 Obsidian 应用里的 Local REST API 插件工作。

findings.item: Memory over long use is hard: commercial chat assistants and long-context models lost 30% of their accuracy across sustained interactions, on 500 questions covering extraction, multi-session reasoning, time, updates and abstention (LongMemEval, ICLR 2025).
findings.item_zh: 长期使用下的记忆很难：在覆盖提取、跨会话推理、时间、更新、拒答的 500 道题上，商用助手和长上下文模型在持续对话中准确率下降 30%（LongMemEval，ICLR 2025）。

findings.item: A memory system has three stages, indexing, retrieval and reading, and each can be improved on its own; the paper's designs for them greatly improved recall and the answers that depend on it (LongMemEval).
findings.item_zh: 记忆系统分三步：建索引、检索、阅读，每一步都能单独改进；论文针对这三步的设计大幅提升了召回，以及依赖召回的回答（LongMemEval）。

findings.item: Very long histories still beat models: across conversations of about 600 turns and 16K tokens over up to 32 sessions, long-context and retrieval-augmented models lagged far behind people (LoCoMo, ACL 2024).
findings.item_zh: 超长历史仍然难倒模型：每段对话约 600 轮、1.6 万 token、最多 32 个会话，用了长上下文或检索增强的模型仍远不如人（LoCoMo，ACL 2024）。

findings.item: Plain files hold up: an agent that searched a conversation file with grep-style tools scored 74.0% on LoCoMo, above the 68.5% Mem0 reported; the authors caution that comparisons across frameworks are rough (Letta, a write-up, not peer-reviewed).
findings.item_zh: 纯文件撑得住：用 grep 一类工具搜索对话文件的 agent 在 LoCoMo 上拿到 74.0%，高于 Mem0 自报的 68.5%；作者也提醒，跨框架比较只能粗看（Letta 评测文章，未经同行评审）。

did.item: Ran 10 of the tools on the same 15 questions about a 560-note test vault, with Claude Code and plain file tools as the control, and marked every answer (gpt-6-astra, three passes). Results are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 让其中 10 个工具回答同一个 560 条笔记测试库的 15 道题，用只带普通文件工具的 Claude Code 做对照，逐题评分（gpt-6-astra，三遍）。结果在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, how does it connect an agent to Obsidian.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、怎样把 agent 接进 Obsidian。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of five kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入五类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: The vault is small and tidy, so the test cannot show what these tools do at tens of thousands of notes, where search quality starts to matter; every tool tied on accuracy. The questions are in English and ask for recall, not for writing or organising notes, which is what most of the skills are for. One run per tool; tools that need the Obsidian desktop app were not run.
not_done.item_zh: 测试库又小又整齐，测不出这些工具在几万条笔记时的表现（那时搜索质量才开始重要）；准确率上所有工具打平。题目是英文的，考的是检索，不是写笔记和整理笔记，而多数 skill 是为后者做的。每个工具只跑一次；需要 Obsidian 桌面应用的没有跑。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

focus.h2: Remotion Skills for Claude Code and Codex
focus.h2_zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 的 Remotion Skill
paragraphs: When people search for a "Remotion skill", they usually mean the official Remotion Agent Skills, which the Remotion team maintains in remotion-dev/skills. It is a set of instruction files for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and Cursor. remotion-best-practices covers everything; narrower ones handle single jobs, such as remotion-create for a new project or composition, remotion-markup for compositions, animation, layout and typography, remotion-studio to open the preview, and remotion-render to export a video or a still.

Install it with the command below; new Remotion projects made with `bun create video` offer the same skills during setup. The official skills teach an agent to write correct Remotion code. They do not decide what your film looks like. The community skills listed after them add that part: ad and promo templates, motion-graphics kits, directing workflows and house styles. method.h2: How we judge Remotion skills and Claude Code video tools: does a file come out, and can you read it
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Remotion skill 和 Claude Code 视频工具：能不能出片，片子上的字读不读得到
method.thesis: A video skill for a coding agent does not generate pixels. It has the agent write a program (a Remotion composition, an HTML page, a Lottie file, an ffmpeg command) and render it. That is why it can put exact words on screen at an exact second, which pixel video models still cannot do reliably, and it is also where it fails: the program has to run. The research on code-made video measures the same few things. In TheoremExplainAgent (ACL 2025), the best agent rendered 93.8% of its explainer videos, and most of the videos that rendered still had minor layout problems such as overlapping elements. In MoVer (SIGGRAPH 2025), 58.8% of generated motion graphics matched the request on the first try and 93.6% after up to 50 rounds of automatic correction. So we judge a video skill on what can be checked from the file: it renders, it is the length and size you asked for, every line of your copy can be read, and the picture moves. Whether it looks good is for your eyes; we show the video.
method.thesis_zh: 给编码 agent 用的视频 skill 并不生成像素。它让 agent 写一段程序（Remotion 组件、HTML 页面、Lottie 文件、ffmpeg 命令）再渲染出来。所以它能在指定的秒数把指定的字准确放到画面上，这一点像素视频模型至今做不稳；它出问题的地方也在这里：程序得跑得通。研究代码生成视频的论文量的也是这几件事。TheoremExplainAgent（ACL 2025）里，最好的 agent 有 93.8% 的讲解视频能渲染出来，而渲染成功的视频大多仍有元素重叠之类的版面小问题。MoVer（SIGGRAPH 2025）里，生成的动效一次就符合要求的占 58.8%，自动修正最多 50 轮后升到 93.6%。所以我们按能从文件里核对的东西来评视频 skill：能渲染、时长和尺寸符合要求、每一句文案都读得到、画面在动。好不好看交给你的眼睛，我们把成片放出来。

八类视频 skill，同一条流水线

routes.name: Frameworks and toolkits
routes.how: Teach the agent a renderer: Remotion, HyperFrames (HTML to video), or a full production toolkit.
routes.how_zh: 教 agent 用一种渲染器：Remotion、HyperFrames（HTML 转视频），或一整套制作工具。
routes.gain: General: any kind of video the renderer can draw.
routes.gain_zh: 通用：渲染器画得出的都能做。
routes.cost: The agent still has to design the video; expect a first render that needs another pass.
routes.cost_zh: 视频还得 agent 自己设计；第一次渲染多半要再改一轮。

routes.name: Promos and product demos
routes.how: A fixed recipe for launch videos: scenes, pacing, sometimes music and sound made in code.
routes.how_zh: 产品发布视频的固定配方：分镜、节奏，有的还用代码做配乐和音效。
routes.gain: Fast to a finished promo with a consistent style.
routes.gain_zh: 很快出一条风格统一的宣传片。
routes.cost: The style is the skill's, not yours; check it fits your brand.
routes.cost_zh: 风格是 skill 的，不是你的；先看合不合你的品牌。

routes.name: Explainers
routes.how: Diagrams, maths and step-by-step animation, often with Manim.
routes.how_zh: 图示、数学和分步动画，常用 Manim。
routes.gain: Clear teaching visuals from a script.
routes.gain_zh: 从脚本直接出清晰的教学画面。
routes.cost: Layout is the weak point in the research: check for overlapping text.
routes.cost_zh: 研究里最弱的一环是版面：留意文字重叠。

routes.name: Motion graphics
routes.how: Logo animations, Lottie files, SVG motion, B-roll loops.
routes.how_zh: Logo 动画、Lottie 文件、SVG 动效、B-roll 循环。
routes.gain: Small reusable pieces for a longer video or a site.
routes.gain_zh: 可复用的小片段，放进长视频或网站。
routes.cost: Timing and direction are what generated motion gets wrong most.
routes.cost_zh: 生成的动效最常错的是时间和方向。

routes.name: Editing and shorts
routes.how: Work on footage you already have: cut, subtitle, reframe, turn long video into shorts.
routes.how_zh: 处理你已有的素材：剪、加字幕、改画幅、长视频切短视频。
routes.gain: Saves the repetitive hours of editing.
routes.gain_zh: 省掉剪辑里重复的那几个小时。
routes.cost: Needs your footage, and often a speech or vision model with its own key.
routes.cost_zh: 要有你自己的素材，常常还要带密钥的语音或视觉模型。

routes.name: Stories, animation and music videos
routes.how: Storyboards and drawn scenes assembled into a film, some with image or video models.
routes.how_zh: 分镜和手绘场景拼成短片，有的会调用图像或视频模型。
routes.gain: A whole short film from a script.
routes.gain_zh: 从剧本直接出一部短片。
routes.cost: Check whether it needs a paid image or video model.
routes.cost_zh: 先看是否需要付费的图像或视频模型。

routes.name: Avatars
routes.how: A presenter video through a hosted avatar service.
routes.how_zh: 通过托管的数字人服务生成主持人视频。
routes.gain: A talking presenter without filming.
routes.gain_zh: 不用拍摄就有出镜讲解。
routes.cost: Always needs an account and credits with that service.
routes.cost_zh: 一定需要该服务的账号和额度。

routes.name: Scripts and learning
routes.how: Screenwriting, directing and prompt-writing skills; no rendering.
routes.how_zh: 编剧、导演和写提示词的 skill；不渲染。
routes.gain: Better input for any of the above.
routes.gain_zh: 给上面任何一类提供更好的输入。
routes.cost: Produces text, not a video.
routes.cost_zh: 产出是文字，不是视频。

method.gap: No peer-reviewed study tests Remotion or HTML-to-video skills themselves. The closest work measures agents writing Manim, SVG and Lottie animation; the one benchmark of HTML and React motion design is a vendor's own. So the checks here borrow those papers' metrics; they are not their findings about these skills.
method.gap_zh: 还没有同行评审的研究直接测 Remotion 或 HTML 转视频的 skill。最接近的工作测的是 agent 写 Manim、SVG 和 Lottie 动画；唯一一个测 HTML 和 React 动效的基准是厂商自己做的。所以这里的检查借用了这些论文的指标，并不是它们对这些 skill 的结论。

h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: Rendering was not the hurdle here. All 16 skills, and Claude Code with no skill, produced a playable 15-second film of the right size with every line of copy readable and nothing added; none needed a paid model.
findings.item_zh: 这次渲染不是门槛。16 个 skill 和不装 skill 的 Claude Code 全都做出了可播放、尺寸正确的 15 秒成片，每句文案都读得到，也没有多加内容；没有一个用到付费模型。

findings.item: A skill changes the look and the time, not whether a film comes out. Time ran from 2.0 to 23.5 minutes; by eye, 10 of 16 films have a look of their own and 6 sit close to what Claude Code makes unprompted.
findings.item_zh: skill 改变的是观感和耗时，不是能不能出片。耗时从 2.0 到 23.5 分钟；按肉眼判断，16 条里 10 条有自己的样子，6 条接近 Claude Code 不给方向时做出来的东西。

findings.item: Rendering is the first hurdle, and it is mostly cleared: the best agent rendered 93.8% of its videos; the failures were mostly calls to functions that do not exist (TheoremExplainAgent, ACL 2025).
findings.item_zh: 渲染是第一道坎，而且多数能过：最好的 agent 有 93.8% 的视频渲染成功；失败大多是调用了并不存在的函数（TheoremExplainAgent，ACL 2025）。

findings.item: The first render is often not the right one. 58.8% of generated motion graphics met the request with no iteration, 93.6% after automatic checking and up to 50 corrections (MoVer, SIGGRAPH 2025).
findings.item_zh: 第一次渲染往往不对。生成的动效不迭代就符合要求的占 58.8%，经过自动检查和最多 50 次修正后是 93.6%（MoVer，SIGGRAPH 2025）。

findings.item: Layout is where code-made video goes wrong: most videos that rendered still had minor layout issues (TheoremExplainAgent), which is why we read the text off the frames instead of trusting the code.
findings.item_zh: 代码生成的视频错在版面：渲染成功的视频大多仍有版面小问题（TheoremExplainAgent），所以我们从画面帧上读字，不只看代码。

findings.item: Text on screen can be checked from the file: sample frames, read the text, compare with what was asked (Deganutti et al., ICML 2026 workshop). Duration and motion are measured the same way, from the file.
findings.item_zh: 画面上的字可以从文件核对：抽帧、读字、和要求的文案对比（Deganutti 等，ICML 2026 workshop）。时长和运动量也一样，从文件里量。

did.item: Had 16 of the skills make the same 15-second film in a throwaway sandbox, with Claude Code and no skill as the control, and checked every file four ways. The films are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 让其中 16 个 skill 在用完即删的沙箱里做同一条 15 秒片子，用不装 skill 的 Claude Code 做对照，每个文件查四项。成片在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software an agent can use.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是 agent 能用的软件。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of ten kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入十类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，并且每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: The brief is short and simple, so it cannot separate these skills on reliability: every one passed. One run per skill; a second run would look different. The look is our judgement by eye, not a measurement, and nobody rated the films for quality. The copy was read off the frames by a model, whose frame numbers we found to be off by one in places, so we report whether a line was readable, not for how long. Editing, avatar and story skills that need footage, an account or a paid model were not in this test.
not_done.item_zh: 这条需求又短又简单，分不出这些 skill 谁更可靠：全部通过。每个 skill 只跑一次，再跑一次画面会不同。观感是我们肉眼的判断，不是测量，也没有人给片子的质量打分。文案是模型从画面帧上读的，我们发现它报的帧号有的地方差一帧，所以只报告某句是否读得到，不报告显示了多久。需要素材、账号或付费模型的剪辑、数字人和故事类 skill 不在这次测试里。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。
