title: Claude Code Hooks, Subagents & Statusline
description: Open-source Claude Code hooks, subagents and statuslines, security-graded: hook guards and formatters, specialist agent collections, usage and context status bars. Vet before you install.

extra_faq.q: What are Claude Code hooks used for?
extra_faq.a: Scripts that run on events such as a tool call, a prompt or the end of a turn: blocking risky commands, formatting files after edits, sending notifications, logging. disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery walks through every hook event with working examples; severity1/claude-code-prompt-improver is a hook that improves prompts before Claude sees them.
extra_faq.qZh: Claude Code hooks 有什么用?
extra_faq.aZh: 在工具调用、提交提示、一轮结束等事件上自动运行的脚本:拦截危险命令、编辑后自动格式化、发通知、记日志。disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery 用可运行的例子讲清每一种 hook 事件;severity1/claude-code-prompt-improver 是一个在 Claude 看到之前先改进提示词的 hook。

extra_faq.q: Where can I find a list of Claude Code hooks, subagents and statuslines?
extra_faq.a: Hooks: disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery. Subagents: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents (100+ specialist subagents). Statuslines: jarrodwatts/claude-hud and sirmalloc/ccstatusline. All are in the open-source list zhuyansen/awesome-claude-code-hooks on GitHub, grouped by type and security-graded.
extra_faq.qZh: 哪里能找到 Claude Code hooks、subagents 和 statusline 的合集?
extra_faq.aZh: Hooks:disler/claude-code-hooks-mastery;Subagents:VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents(100 多个专家子代理);状态栏:jarrodwatts/claude-hud、sirmalloc/ccstatusline。它们都收录在 GitHub 开源合集 zhuyansen/awesome-claude-code-hooks 里,按类型分组并做了安全评级。

method.h2: How we judge Claude Code hooks, subagents and statuslines: enforce, don't advise
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么评 Claude Code hooks、子代理和状态栏：要强制，不要提醒
method.thesis: Claude Code follows instructions most of the time; Claude Code hooks make some things happen every time. The research shows why that difference matters. In over 5,000 Claude Code runs on SWE-bench Verified, rule files helped (+13.8 points), but random rules helped as much as curated ones; every rule that helped on its own was a prohibition ("do not refactor unrelated code") and every rule that hurt was a directive ("follow code style"). A prohibition is what a hook can enforce. AgentSpec, a runtime rule of trigger, check and action, which is the shape of a Claude Code hook, prevented unsafe execution in over 90% of code-agent cases with overhead in milliseconds (ICSE 2026). Guardrails learned from failed runs cut abnormal executions of Claude Code from 69.0% to 26.7% and raised task completion from 21.7% to 35.0%. Statuslines answer a different failure: models use information in the middle of a long context worst, so it pays to see how full the context is. So we judge these tools by whether they enforce rather than advise, whether they keep the context lean and visible, and what they run on your machine.
method.thesis_zh: Claude Code 大多数时候会照指令做；Claude Code hooks 让有些事每次都发生。研究说明了这个差别为什么重要。在 SWE-bench Verified 上跑了 5,000 多次 Claude Code，规则文件有帮助（+13.8 个百分点），但随机规则和精选规则一样有用；单独看，有帮助的规则全是禁止型（"不要重构无关代码"），有害的规则全是指令型（"遵循代码风格"）。禁止型规则正是 hook 能强制执行的。AgentSpec 用"触发、检查、动作"写运行时规则，这正是 Claude Code hook 的形状，它拦下了 90% 以上代码 agent 的不安全执行，开销是毫秒级（ICSE 2026）。从失败轨迹里学出来的护栏，把 Claude Code 的异常执行率从 69.0% 降到 26.7%，任务完成率从 21.7% 升到 35.0%。状态栏解决的是另一种失败：长上下文中间的信息，模型用得最差，所以要看得见上下文有多满。所以我们看这些工具：是强制还是只提醒，能否让上下文精简、可见，以及它在你机器上执行了什么。
h3_routes: Five kinds of Claude Code hooks and add-ons
五类 Claude Code hooks 与扩展

routes.name: Hooks
routes.how: Shell commands Claude Code runs at fixed points: before a tool call, after an edit, at the end of a session.
routes.how_zh: Claude Code 在固定时机执行的 shell 命令：调用工具前、编辑后、会话结束时。
routes.gain: Deterministic: a blocked command stays blocked, a formatter or test run happens every time.
routes.gain_zh: 确定性：被拦的命令一定被拦，格式化和测试每次都跑。
routes.cost: They run with your permissions on every event; read the script before you add it.
routes.cost_zh: 每个事件都以你的权限执行；加之前先读脚本。

routes.name: Subagents
routes.how: Specialist agents with their own prompt and their own context window.
routes.how_zh: 有自己提示词和独立上下文窗口的专职 agent。
routes.gain: Side work stays out of the main context.
routes.gain_zh: 支线工作不占主上下文。
routes.cost: No study has measured subagent packs yet; a pack of 100 is the too-many-skills problem again.
routes.cost_zh: 还没有研究专门测过子代理合集；一次装 100 个，又回到了 skill 装太多的问题。

routes.name: Statuslines
routes.how: A line under the prompt with the model, context used, cost and git state.
routes.how_zh: 输入框下面的一行，显示模型、上下文用量、费用和 git 状态。
routes.gain: You see the context filling up before answers get worse.
routes.gain_zh: 在回答变差之前，就能看到上下文快满了。
routes.cost: Reads your session data; check whether it sends anything anywhere.
routes.cost_zh: 会读会话数据；看看它有没有往外发送东西。

routes.name: Collections
routes.how: Bundles of hooks, agents, commands and rules.
routes.how_zh: hooks、agent、命令和规则的打包合集。
routes.gain: A starting point to copy from.
routes.gain_zh: 可以照抄的起点。
routes.cost: Install the parts you use; bundled directives ("always follow X") are the kind of rule the research found can hurt.
routes.cost_zh: 只装用得上的；合集里的指令型规则（"总是遵循 X"）正是研究发现可能有害的那类。

routes.name: Tooling
routes.how: Generators and managers that write hooks, agents and settings for you.
routes.how_zh: 帮你生成和管理 hooks、agent、设置的工具。
routes.gain: No hand-editing of settings JSON.
routes.gain_zh: 不用手改设置 JSON。
routes.cost: Check what it writes into your settings before you accept it.
routes.cost_zh: 它往设置里写了什么，确认前先看一眼。

method.gap: The studies measure rules and runtime guardrails for coding agents, not the repositories listed here, and none has tested statuslines or subagent packs directly. The rows for those two are our reading, not the research's finding.
method.gap_zh: 这些研究测的是编程 agent 的规则和运行时护栏，不是这页列出的仓库；也还没有研究直接测过状态栏和子代理合集。这两行是我们的解读，不是研究结论。

h3_questions: Four questions we ask of every Claude Code hook or add-on
每个 Claude Code hook 或扩展我们问四个问题

questions.q: Enforce or advise: does it block the action, or only remind the agent?
questions.q_zh: 强制还是提醒：它会拦下动作，还是只提醒 agent？

questions.q: Prohibitions: are its rules "do not" with a check behind them, rather than "always do"?
questions.q_zh: 禁止型：它的规则是带检查的"不要做"，而不是"总是要做"？

questions.q: Context: does it keep the main context lean, or show you how full it is?
questions.q_zh: 上下文：它让主上下文更精简，或者让你看见上下文有多满？

questions.q: What runs: which commands does it execute, on which events, with what network access?
questions.q_zh: 执行了什么：在哪些事件上执行哪些命令，能不能联网？

floor_activity: while they run as hooks, subagents or statuslines
作为 hook、子代理或状态栏运行时的行为
h3_findings: What our test and the research found
实测和研究发现了什么

findings.item: Half of the guard hooks stopped nothing we tried. With Claude Code's permission prompts skipped, 6 of 12 hooks let all eight risky actions through; one (nomos) stopped seven, the next best four.
findings.item_zh: 一半的守卫 hook 什么都没拦住。跳过 Claude Code 的权限确认时，12 个 hook 里 6 个让八个危险动作全部通过；只有一个（nomos）拦下七个，第二名拦下四个。

findings.item: Claude Code's own prompts are a strong baseline and a noisy one: with no hook they stopped 7 of 8 risky actions and asked about 3 of 4 ordinary ones. Printing .env was the one risky action they let through.
findings.item_zh: Claude Code 自带的确认是一条很强、但很吵的基线：不装 hook 时拦下 8 个危险动作里的 7 个，4 个正常动作里也有 3 个要确认。唯一放过的危险动作是打印 .env。

findings.item: A permission gate is switched off by --dangerously-skip-permissions. ccgate and Dippy stopped nothing in that mode, and six or seven of eight with prompts kept, while letting ordinary work through unasked.
findings.item_zh: --dangerously-skip-permissions 会把权限闸门关掉。ccgate 和 Dippy 在那种模式下什么都没拦；保留确认时拦下八个里的六到七个，同时让正常工作免确认通过。

findings.item: Prohibitions help, directives can hurt: across 679 rule files and over 5,000 Claude Code runs, every rule that helped on its own was a "do not", every one that hurt was a "do"; random rules helped as much as curated ones (+13.8 points, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 禁止型有用，指令型可能有害：679 个规则文件、5,000 多次 Claude Code 运行里，单独看有帮助的规则全是"不要"，有害的全是"要"；随机规则和精选规则一样有用（+13.8 个百分点，预印本）。

findings.item: Runtime rules work: rules of trigger, check and action prevented unsafe execution in over 90% of code-agent cases, at millisecond overhead; rules a model wrote caught 87.26% of risky code (AgentSpec, ICSE 2026).
findings.item_zh: 运行时规则有效："触发、检查、动作"式规则拦下 90% 以上代码 agent 的不安全执行，开销毫秒级；由模型自动写的规则识别出 87.26% 的风险代码（AgentSpec，ICSE 2026）。

findings.item: Guardrails learned from failures pay off twice: on 100 held-out tasks, Claude Code with Haiku 4.5 went from 69.0% to 26.7% abnormal executions and from 21.7% to 35.0% completed tasks (AgentGuard, a preprint).
findings.item_zh: 从失败里学出的护栏两头都赚：在 100 个留出任务上，Claude Code（Haiku 4.5）的异常执行率从 69.0% 降到 26.7%，任务完成率从 21.7% 升到 35.0%（AgentGuard，预印本）。

findings.item: Where information sits in a long context matters: models use it best at the beginning or end and worst in the middle, including models built for long inputs (Lost in the Middle, TACL).
findings.item_zh: 信息在长上下文里的位置很重要：放在开头或结尾用得最好，放在中间最差，专为长输入设计的模型也一样（Lost in the Middle，TACL）。

did.item: Installed 12 guard hooks one at a time in a throwaway sandbox and attempted the same 12 actions on a canary project, twice each (permission prompts skipped, and kept), with no hook as the control. Results are in the test section above and on each card.
did.item_zh: 在用完即删的沙箱里逐个安装 12 个守卫 hook，对金丝雀项目做同样的 12 个动作，各跑两遍（跳过权限确认、保留权限确认），并以不装 hook 作对照。结果在上面的实测区和每张卡片上。

did.item: Found the candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README: is it on topic, is it software, what does it hook into.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 逐个读 README：是否切题、是不是软件、挂在 Claude Code 的哪个环节。

did.item: Sorted every entry into one of five kinds, so you can filter.
did.item_zh: 把每个条目归入五类之一，可以筛选。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and ranked the list by GitHub stars.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，列表按 GitHub 星数排序。

did.item: Re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: One run per hook, on 12 actions we chose; a hook built for another threat (prompt injection, remote commands, git hygiene) scores zero here without being useless. The agent was told to attempt every action, so this measures the hook, not the model's own caution. Hooks were installed by an agent following each README, with default settings.
not_done.item_zh: 每个 hook 只跑一次，12 个动作是我们自己定的；为别的威胁设计的 hook（提示注入、远程命令、git 规范）在这里得零分，不代表没用。agent 被要求每个动作都要尝试，所以测的是 hook，不是模型自己的谨慎。hook 由 agent 按各自 README 的默认设置安装。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the hook run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察 hook 运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。

title: AI Reverse Engineering Tools
description: Open-source AI reverse engineering tools, security-graded: Ghidra MCP and IDA Pro MCP servers, jadx and Frida for mobile apps, reverse engineering skills, REA, and programs rebuilt with it.

extra_faq.q: What is a Ghidra MCP server?
extra_faq.a: A bridge that lets an AI agent drive Ghidra: list functions, read decompiled code, rename symbols and add comments. LaurieWired/GhidraMCP is the most starred; bethington/ghidra-mcp is a larger one that also runs headless. mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp does the same job for IDA Pro.
extra_faq.qZh: Ghidra MCP 是什么?
extra_faq.aZh: 一座让 AI agent 操作 Ghidra 的桥:列出函数、读反编译代码、给符号改名、加注释。星数最高的是 LaurieWired/GhidraMCP;bethington/ghidra-mcp 功能更多,还能无界面运行。mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp 为 IDA Pro 做同样的事。

extra_faq.q: Which repository is the official REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)?
extra_faq.a: morluto/rea. We found 9 other repositories that copy or translate it, one with more than 200 stars; they are named in the table on this page and are not listed. We checked that their README is a copy, not what their code does, so install from morluto/rea.

extra_faq.aZh: morluto/rea。我们另外找到 9 个照搬或翻译它的仓库,其中一个超过 200 星;它们列在本页的表格里,不在收录清单中。我们只核对了它们的 README 是复制的,没有检查代码做了什么,所以请从 morluto/rea 安装。

extra_faq.q: What has been reverse engineered with REA?
extra_faq.a: Four projects here say in their README that REA was used: a rebuild of DX-Ball 1.07 in C/C++ (N0zoM1z0/dx-ball), a port layer that runs a 2002 Windows game on macOS (OceanJy333/meteor-mac), a save editor for Total War: Warhammer 3 (davehornik/WH3SaveEditor) and an analysis of the netcat binary (NullLabTests/OpenBSD_netcat_REA). None of them ships the original program's files.
extra_faq.qZh: 有哪些项目是用 REA 逆向出来的?
extra_faq.aZh: 本页有四个项目在 README 里写明用了 REA:用 C/C++ 重建 DX-Ball 1.07(N0zoM1z0/dx-ball)、让 2002 年的 Windows 游戏在 macOS 上运行的兼容层(OceanJy333/meteor-mac)、《全面战争:战锤 3》存档编辑器(davehornik/WH3SaveEditor),以及对 netcat 二进制的分析(NullLabTests/OpenBSD_netcat_REA)。它们都不附带原程序的文件。

method.h2: How we chose these AI reverse engineering tools: what the agent is connected to
method.h2_zh: 我们怎么选这些 AI 逆向工程工具：agent 接的是什么
method.thesis: An AI agent does not reverse engineer by itself. It reads what a disassembler, a decompiler or a debugger gives it, so the first question is which of those it is connected to. The page is grouped by that, and a repository is listed only when reverse engineering with an agent is its main purpose.
method.thesis_zh: AI agent 自己不会逆向。它读的是反汇编器、反编译器或调试器给它的结果，所以第一个问题是它接的是哪一个。本页按这一点分组；一个仓库只有以「用 agent 做逆向」为主要用途才会收录。
h3_routes: Five kinds, by what the agent works on
五种类型，按 agent 处理的对象分

routes.name: Disassembler and decompiler MCP
routes.how: A server or plugin that lets the agent drive Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, radare2 or x64dbg: list functions, read decompiled code, rename, comment.
routes.how_zh: 一个服务或插件，让 agent 操作 Ghidra、IDA Pro、Binary Ninja、radare2 或 x64dbg：列函数、读反编译代码、改名、加注释。
routes.gain: The agent works inside the tool you already use, on the database you already have.
routes.gain_zh: agent 就在你已经在用的工具里干活，用的是你现成的分析库。
routes.cost: You need the tool itself, and for IDA Pro and Binary Ninja a licence. Check which version the plugin supports.
routes.cost_zh: 得先有工具本身，IDA Pro 和 Binary Ninja 还要授权。看清插件支持哪个版本。

routes.name: Mobile app reversing
routes.how: jadx, apktool or Frida connected to the agent, for Android, iOS or HarmonyOS apps.
routes.how_zh: 把 jadx、apktool 或 Frida 接给 agent，面向 Android、iOS 或鸿蒙应用。
routes.gain: Reads an APK's code and resources, or hooks a running app.
routes.gain_zh: 能读 APK 的代码和资源，或者挂钩运行中的应用。
routes.cost: Frida tools act on a live device. Use a test device, not your own phone.
routes.cost_zh: Frida 类工具作用于真机。用测试机，别用自己的手机。

routes.name: Web, JS and protocol reversing
routes.how: Tools for obfuscated JavaScript, request signing and traffic analysis.
routes.how_zh: 针对混淆 JavaScript、请求签名和流量分析的工具。
routes.gain: Works from a browser, no disassembler needed.
routes.gain_zh: 从浏览器入手，不需要反汇编器。
routes.cost: The smallest group here, and a site's terms may forbid what these tools do.
routes.cost_zh: 这一类条目最少；网站的服务条款可能禁止这些操作。

routes.name: Reverse engineering skills
routes.how: Instructions and workflows that teach the agent how to approach a target and which tool to call.
routes.how_zh: 教 agent 怎么分析目标、该调用哪个工具的说明与流程。
routes.gain: Installs in one step and works with the tools above.
routes.gain_zh: 一步装好，可以和上面的工具配合。
routes.cost: A skill is text. What it can do depends on the tools the agent can reach.
routes.cost_zh: skill 只是文字，能做到什么取决于 agent 够得着哪些工具。

routes.name: Reverse-engineered with AI
routes.how: Programs rebuilt or analysed with REA, where the README says so.
routes.how_zh: 用 REA 重建或分析出来的程序，README 里写明了这一点。
routes.gain: Shows what the approach produces, with the source to read.
routes.gain_zh: 能看到这条路做出来的东西，源码可读。
routes.cost: Small and new: three of the four have fewer than ten stars.
routes.cost_zh: 又小又新：四个里有三个不到十星。

method.gap: What none of these changes: you need the right to analyse the target. Unpacking and anti-debugging are ordinary reverse engineering and are listed. Repositories whose selling point is game cheating or cracking software are not.
method.gap_zh: 这些工具都不改变一件事：你得有权分析那个目标。脱壳和反调试属于正常的逆向，会收录。以游戏作弊或破解软件为卖点的仓库不收录。

h3_findings: What the review found
审核中发现了什么

findings.item: The wave around REA is mostly not software. Of 917 repositories that mention it, 157 have at least one star; about half of those are unrelated to it.
findings.item_zh: 围绕 REA 的这一波，大部分不是软件。917 个提到它的仓库里，157 个至少有一颗星；其中约一半其实与它无关。

findings.item: A model's label is not enough for "made with REA". It marked 17 repositories as such; reading each README left 10, and 4 are listed.
findings.item_zh: 「用 REA 做的」不能只信模型的判断。模型标了 17 个，逐个读 README 后剩 10 个，收录 4 个。

findings.item: Copies travel with the original. Nine repositories repeat or translate morluto/rea, one with more than 200 stars. They are named in the table below.
findings.item_zh: 原版火了，复制品跟着来。有九个仓库照搬或翻译 morluto/rea，其中一个超过 200 星。它们列在下面的表里。

did.item: Found 618 candidates on GitHub (every star count) and in our catalog, then had Jev, TypeSafe's decision model, read each README against the questions above.
did.item_zh: 在 GitHub（不限星数）和我们的目录里找到 618 个候选，再让 TypeSafe 的决策模型 Jev 按上面的问题逐个读 README。

did.item: Read by hand the README and file list of every repository listed as made with REA, and checked that none ships the original program's files.
did.item_zh: 凡是列为「用 REA 做的」的仓库，都人工读了 README 和文件列表，并确认没有附带原程序的文件。

did.item: Compared the README of each suspected copy with the official one.
did.item_zh: 把每个疑似复制品的 README 和官方版逐一比对。

did.item: Security-graded every repo against 42 published rules, and re-check the list every day: new repos are reviewed, deleted and renamed ones removed.
did.item_zh: 按 42 条公开规则给每个仓库做安全评级，并且每天复查：新仓库进审核，删除和改名的移出。

not_done.item: We did not run these tools: nothing here was tested against a binary, and we did not check what the code of the copies does.
not_done.item_zh: 我们没有实际运行这些工具：没有拿任何一个去分析二进制，也没有检查复制品的代码做了什么。

not_done.item: A security grade reads what a repository says and contains; it does not watch the tool run.
not_done.item_zh: 安全评级看的是仓库写了什么、包含什么，不是观察工具运行时的行为。

not_done.item: No one pays to be listed or ranked here.
not_done.item_zh: 没有任何条目是付费上榜或付费排名的。
